tools.name: check_username
tools.description: Check whether ONE username or store name is available on reselling platforms: eBay, eBay Store, Poshmark, Grailed, Vinted, Whatnot, Bonanza, and Chairish are looked up directly, but several of them (often eBay, Grailed, Whatnot, and Chairish) block automated lookups and then come back as unverified

tools.name: compare_fees
tools.description: Compare what a sale pays out after marketplace fees on eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Etsy, Grailed, and Vinted (US sellers). Takes the sale price in USD and, optionally, the shipping charged to the buyer, the item cost, the seller's own shipping cost, and an eBay promoted listing rate; with costs
